title: 17th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) guide me to the virtuous deeds,
and settle on this day all my needs and hopes.

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ اِلَى التَّفْسِيْرِ وَالسُّؤَالِ،
verses.translation: O He Who does not require explanation or wonderment!

verses.arabic: يَا عالِمًا بِمَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ،
verses.translation: O He Who knows what is hidden in the chest of the peoples,
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household the immaculate.
